large_object_case.description: Test fixture requirement: produce a complete logical-object JSON UTF-8 snapshot and its unchunked transport representation that each exceed a deliberately configured, measured individual-record budget. Chunk payloads, descriptors, manifest and other staged records must each fit that same measured per-record budget. The exact generated bytes, lengths, and SHA-256 values are runtime outputs, not constants asserted here.

repetition.unit: synthetic payload block with escaped quotes, CRLF, Unicode and unknown nested fields

large_object_case.expected: complete reconstruction byte-equals the retained intended snapshot; otherwise limit-exceeded before mutation

cases.name: valid-two-chunk-profile-2
cases.expected: verify indexes, offsets, lengths and computed digests; concatenate and compare all recovered bytes to the retained snapshot; strict standard base64 decode/re-encode must match the exact wire

cases.name: out-of-order
cases.expected: fail index/offset validation; do not reorder to mask malformed manifest

cases.name: transformed-wire
cases.mutation: alter CRLF or a Unicode scalar in the logical/source bytes, then produce a valid padded base64 encoding of those altered bytes
cases.expected: the validly re-encoded transport still fails comparison with the original retained snapshot bytes

cases.name: truncated-read
cases.mutation: remove final encoded bytes while retaining apparent preview

cases.name: bad-count-or-digest
cases.mutation: manifest count or digest differs from measured complete traversal

cases.name: root-race
cases.mutation: root wire/revision differs on final re-read
cases.expected: conflict/restart reconciliation; no claim of stable completeness

profile_2_cases.name: unicode-crlf-metadata-relations-preserved
profile_2_cases.expected: the retained snapshot and exact readback preserve Unicode scalars, CRLF/LF distinctions, unknown nested metadata, missing-versus-null distinctions, relation order and unknown relation fields

profile_2_cases.name: equivalent-json-different-serialization
input_variants: same logical JSON value serialized with different permitted whitespace/key ordering
same logical JSON value serialized with another standard serializer
profile_2_cases.expected: each retained byte snapshot has its own measured length and digest; never require serializers to emit identical bytes and never invent hashes

profile_2_cases.name: truncated-or-corrupt-base64
profile_2_cases.expected: strict standard decoder rejects malformed/truncated encoding or recovered bytes fail full snapshot equality; no partial success

profile_2_cases.name: profile-boundary-mismatch
profile_2_cases.mutation: locator storage_profile, binding, JAIBA2 prefix, or envelope format disagree or are missing/unknown
profile_2_cases.expected: block before interpretation; do not fallback or sniff

profile_2_cases.name: legacy-jaiba1-is-not-profile-2
profile_2_cases.expected: keep explicitly identified historical profile-1 fixture; never decode/relabel/reinterpret as profile 2

static_vs_behavioral.static_checks: JSON shape and declared cases can be reviewed statically.
static_vs_behavioral.behavioral_checks: Profile-2 JSON UTF-8 snapshot retention, computed digest/byte count, chunk reconstruction and full exact readback require actual verified computation/tool invocations; these fixtures alone do not execute or certify them. Literal profile precondition checks are not delivered-skill behavior or backend conformance.
